_meta: Face rig parameters per frame, written by tools/face_fit.py from truth + bench/cameras.json. Decal: u viewer right, v down, R units, origin between the eyes. pose: yaw pitch roll on the head sphere. cam: the camera the fit saw. lid/brow: 8 cubic + 5 widths. dome: cu cv rx ry tilt egg. mouth stroke: 8 cubic + 7 widths; grid: cu cv hw hh tilt ex ol hy x1 x2 x3 lw skew.
